objective: sum over hours of step_hours * (export_price * discharge - import_price * charge)

hour.description: Hour of the day as start-end clock hours (00-01 = midnight to 1 am)
hour.label: hour

order.description: Position in the day (1 = first hour). Consecutive hours are linked by the battery's stored energy
order.label: hour order

step_hours.description: Length of the time step; powers in kW are multiplied by it to get energy in kWh. Structural: the 24 steps partition the day into hours.
step_hours.label: step length

import_price.description: Price paid for each kWh bought from the grid, which is what charging the battery costs
import_price.label: grid import price (EUR/kWh)

export_price.description: Price received for each kWh sold to the grid, which is what discharging the battery earns
export_price.label: grid export price (EUR/kWh)

energy_capacity_kwh.description: Usable energy capacity of the battery; the stored energy never exceeds it
energy_capacity_kwh.label: battery energy capacity (kWh)

max_charge_kw.description: Most power the battery can draw from the grid in any hour
max_charge_kw.label: maximum charging power (kW)

max_discharge_kw.description: Most power the battery can deliver to the grid in any hour
max_discharge_kw.label: maximum discharging power (kW)

charge_efficiency.description: Share of the energy drawn from the grid for charging that ends up stored in the battery
charge_efficiency.label: charging efficiency

discharge_efficiency.description: Share of the energy taken out of the battery for discharging that reaches the grid; the battery gives up energy at 1 / discharge_efficiency per kWh delivered
discharge_efficiency.label: discharging efficiency

initial_soc_kwh.description: Energy stored in the battery at the start of the day
initial_soc_kwh.label: battery charge at the start of the day (kWh)

terminal_soc_kwh.description: Least energy the battery must hold at the end of the last hour
terminal_soc_kwh.label: minimum battery charge at the end of the day (kWh)

decision_variables.charge[hour]: battery charging power drawn from the grid, kW (0..max_charge_kw)
decision_variables.discharge[hour]: battery discharging power delivered to the grid, kW (0..max_discharge_kw)
decision_variables.soc[hour]: energy stored in the battery at the end of the hour, kWh (0..energy_capacity_kwh)

constraints.soc_balance[hour]: soc = soc[previous hour] + charge_efficiency * step_hours * charge - step_hours / discharge_efficiency * discharge (initial_soc_kwh before the first hour)
